tips.title: How to cut heater electricity costs
items: Set a timer so the heater switches off after you fall asleep; daily hours drop accordingly.
Use high-power heaters such as fan heaters and electric stoves only to warm the air briefly, and use an electric mat or blanket that warms you directly when you stay put for long.
Weather strips, window insulation film and thick curtains keep heat in, so thermostat-controlled heaters run for less time.
Cover electric and hot-water mats with a blanket to keep the heat in, and turn the temperature down once warm.
If your usage is just over a tier boundary (200/400 kWh), a small cut drops you to the lower tier and lowers both the base fee and the unit rate.
Check this month's usage in the KEPCO ON app to see which tier you are heading for.
